groups.name: wow.cosid
groups.description: wow-cosid's settings, `wow.cosid.*`: the one default of each key, and the class its configuration metadata comes from. The module imports no Spring Boot, so WowCosIdAutoConfiguration reads its key from Spring's `Environment`, falling back to the default here; the host knows the key from the metadata this module ships.

properties.name: wow.cosid.aggregate-generator
properties.description: The CosId generator, by its name in `cosid.generators`, of the aggregate types that `wow.aggregates.[<context>.<aggregate>].id-generator` does not name and that have no CosId generator named after them (`<context>.<aggregate>`): CosId's `default` generator when not set. It must be one of CosId's generators, or the node does not start. The node's own ids (request, command, wait ids) are never CosId's.
